text.body: oṃ śrīrāmāya namaḥ | oṃ rāmabhadrāya namaḥ | oṃ rāmacaṃdrāya namaḥ | oṃ śāśvatāya namaḥ | oṃ rājīvalocanāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīmate namaḥ | oṃ rājeṃdrāya namaḥ | oṃ raghupuṅgavāya namaḥ | oṃ jānakīvallabhāya namaḥ | oṃ jaitrāya namaḥ || 10|| oṃ jitāmitrāya namaḥ | oṃ janārdanāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvāmitrapriyāya namaḥ | oṃ dāṃtāya namaḥ | oṃ śaraṇatrāṇatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ vālipramathanāya namaḥ | oṃ vāgmine namaḥ | oṃ satyavāce namaḥ | oṃ satyavikramāya namaḥ | oṃ satyavratāya namaḥ || 20|| oṃ vratadharāya namaḥ | oṃ sadāhanumadāśritāya namaḥ | oṃ kausaleyāya namaḥ | oṃ kharadhvaṃsine namaḥ | oṃ virādhavadhapaṃḍitāya namaḥ | oṃ vibhīṣaṇaparitrātre namaḥ | oṃ harakodaṇḍakhaṇḍanāya namaḥ | oṃ saptatālaprabhetre namaḥ | oṃ daśagrīvaśiroharāya namaḥ | oṃ jāmadagnyamahādarpadalanāya namaḥ || 30|| oṃ tāṭakāṃtakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāṃtasārāya namaḥ | oṃ vedātmane namaḥ | oṃ bhavarogasya bheṣajāya namaḥ | oṃ dūṣaṇatriśirohaṃtre namaḥ | oṃ trimūrtaye namaḥ | oṃ triguṇātmakāya namaḥ | oṃ trivikramāya namaḥ | oṃ trilokātmane namaḥ | oṃ puṇyacāritrakīrtanāya namaḥ || 40|| oṃ trilokarakṣakāya namaḥ | oṃ dhanvine namaḥ | oṃ daṃḍakāraṇyavartanāya namaḥ | oṃ ahalyāśāpavimocanāya namaḥ | oṃ pitṛbhaktāya namaḥ | oṃ varapradāya namaḥ | oṃ jiteṃdriyāya namaḥ | oṃ jitakrodhāya namaḥ | oṃ jitamitrāya namaḥ | oṃ jagadgurave namaḥ || 50|| oṃ ṛkṣavānarasaṅghātine namaḥ | oṃ citrakūṭasamāśrayāya namaḥ | oṃ jayaṃtatrāṇavaradāya namaḥ | oṃ sumitrāputrasevitāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadevādidevāya namaḥ | oṃ mṛtavānarajīvanāya namaḥ | oṃ māyāmārīcahaṃtre namaḥ | oṃ mahādevāya namaḥ | oṃ mahābhujāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadevastutāya namaḥ || 60|| oṃ saumyāya namaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇyāya namaḥ | oṃ munisaṃstutāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāyogine namaḥ | oṃ mahodarāya namaḥ | oṃ sugrīvepsitarājyadāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvapuṇyādhikaphalāya namaḥ | oṃ smṛtasarvaughanāśanāya namaḥ | oṃ ādipuruṣāya namaḥ | oṃ paramapuruṣāya namaḥ || 70|| oṃ mahāpuruṣāya namaḥ | oṃ puṇyodayāya namaḥ | oṃ dayāsārāya namaḥ | oṃ purāṇapuruṣottamāya namaḥ | oṃ smitavaktrāya namaḥ | oṃ mitabhāṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ pūrvabhāṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ rāghavāya namaḥ | oṃ anaṃtaguṇagaṃbhīrāya namaḥ | oṃ dhīrodāttaguṇottamāya namaḥ || 80|| oṃ māyāmānuṣacāritrāya namaḥ | oṃ mahādevādipūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ setukṛte namaḥ | oṃ jitavārāśaye namaḥ | oṃ sarvatīrthamayāya namaḥ | oṃ haraye namaḥ | oṃ śyāmāṅgāya namaḥ | oṃ suṃdarāya namaḥ | oṃ śūrāya namaḥ | oṃ pītavāsase namaḥ || 90|| oṃ dhanurdharāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvayajñādhipāya namaḥ | oṃ yajvine namaḥ | oṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitāya namaḥ | oṃ śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhātre namaḥ | oṃ sarvāpaguṇavarjitāya namaḥ | oṃ paramātmane namaḥ | oṃ parabrahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ saccidānaṃdavigrahāya namaḥ | oṃ paraṃjyotiṣe namaḥ || 100|| oṃ paraṃdhāmne namaḥ | oṃ parākāśāya namaḥ | oṃ parātparāya namaḥ | oṃ pareśāya namaḥ | oṃ pāragāya namaḥ | oṃ pārāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadevātmakāya namaḥ | oṃ parasmai namaḥ || 108|| iti śrīrāmāṣṭottaraśatanāmāvalissamāptā |
